headline: Argentina Energy Trade Surplus Reaches $11 Billion Amid Oil and Gas Expansion
summary: Argentina achieved an energy trade surplus of $11 billion after doubling crude extraction and constructing new pipeline infrastructure to scale natural gas deliveries.
why: Growing output from the Vaca Muerta shale formation is transforming Argentina into a net energy exporter, supplying crucial foreign exchange reserves.

impacts.name: YPF
impacts.why: A widening national energy export surplus directly supports state and private energy operators in the Vaca Muerta basin.
